title: TOP 4 Basics Steps / How to Tahitian Dance Tutorial/ Ori Tahiti Polynesian Dance/ Workout/ Training

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses a friendly and encouraging tone, breaking down steps clearly while maintaining good posture and form. She demonstrates movements from multiple angles and combines verbal explanations with continuous practice.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the workout focusing on top basics.
Checks posture, neck height, knees, and neutral pelvis position.
Explains and demonstrates the first basic step, Tamau.
Explains and demonstrates the second basic step, Ami.
Explains and demonstrates the third basic step, Varu.
Explains and demonstrates the fourth basic step, Fa'arapu.
Practice session combining all steps with music from the back view.

cues: Keep your upper body still at all times
safety: Check your posture back straight like this neck tall
Bend your knees during the workout

steps_taught.name: Tamau
steps_taught.description: Sway hips side to side keeping upper body still.

steps_taught.name: Ami
steps_taught.description: Circular motion with hips making a big circle.

steps_taught.name: Varu
steps_taught.description: Figure eight hip twist movement front and back.

what_works: Clear verbal instructions combined with visual demonstration
Progressing from slow to faster tempo
Showing steps from both front and side angles

quotes.text: So first check your posture back straight like this neck tall
Keep your upper body still at all times
So I don't move my head and I twist those hips

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands in front of a branded wall, welcoming viewers and explaining the class topic.
Teacher demonstrates Tamau step by shifting hips side to side with knees bent.
Teacher demonstrates Ami step with circular hip rotations.
evidence_segments.viewpoint: front and close-up leg view, unmirrored

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates Varu step (figure eight) with upper body stable.
evidence_segments.viewpoint: front and close-up leg view, unmirrored

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher practices the routine facing away from the camera with arms outstretched.

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining detailed breakdown of individual hip isolation techniques with continuous fitness-style repetition rounds from the back view.
